Class StockexchangeLinkResolver

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.instrument.lookup.StockexchangeLinkResolver
public final class StockexchangeLinkResolver extends Object
Proposes the stock exchange hyperlink of a listing from a template per MIC, for exchanges whose listing page follows from the ticker or the ISIN alone. The templates reproduce the links users maintain in the production data, e.g. https://www.nasdaq.com/de/market-activity/stocks/mndy, https://www.nyse.com/quote/XNYS:PG and https://www.gpw.pl/company-factsheet?isin=PLPKO0000016. The pages of SIX, Deutsche Börse, Wiener Börse and Euronext are set by their own master data.

Each template was checked against the live page (2026-10-12). Exchanges without such a page are left out: the Nordic exchanges and BIVA address a listing by an internal id, which NasdaqNordicSecuritySearch and BivaSecuritySearch resolve; Hamburg, Berlin, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Jakarta, B3 and Cairo offer no stable listing URL from ticker or ISIN. Where a page exists only for shares (Korea, Stuttgart, Munich, Madrid, Moscow), other instruments get none.

  • Method Details

    • resolve

      public static String resolve(String mic, String ticker, String isin, String name, SpecialInvestmentInstruments sii, Locale locale)
      Derives the stock exchange hyperlink.
      Parameters:
      mic - MIC of the listing
      ticker - exchange ticker, e.g. AAPL, 7203 in Tokyo, 0700 in Hong Kong; may be null
      isin - ISIN of the listing; may be null
      name - name of the instrument, which London shows in the path; may be null
      sii - derived financial instrument; NASDAQ and Borsa Italiana keep ETFs on their own path, several exchanges serve shares only
      locale - language of the user; NASDAQ offers a German page, TMX a French one
      Returns:
      the hyperlink, or null when no template applies
